verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix jawi masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha onh tik te ayto kuj ko b'a et'ok.
T'a yalanhtaxo ayik aytooch winhaj Saúl ko reyalok, a ach onh a kuchb'ejnak t'a owal. Anheja' pax Jehová alannak t'ayach to a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej yet' och ko reyalok, xchi heb'.

Yakb'an ayek' heb' ta', haxo heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel ix lolon yet' winhaj David chi' yik sb'oankan strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ixlajwi chi', ix ak'jikank'e akeite t'a sjolom winh yik sik'jikanoch winh sreyalok masanil heb' israel.
Ayik ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal, 30 ab'il sk'inal winh. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.
Nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá t'a Hebrón. Ixlajwi chi', 33 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a masanil heb' israel yet' t'a heb' aj Judá t'a Jerusalén.

Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo ay t'a Jerusalén. Ix sna' heb' jebuseo chi' to max yal-laj yoch winhaj David chi' t'a yol schonhab' heb' chi', yuj chi' ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: k'okb'ilnhej heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, a heb' max ach chaan ochta t'a tik, xchi heb'.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix yal heb', palta ix yak' ganar chonhab' Sion winh rey chi', yuj chi' schonhab' winhaj David ix sb'iejkani.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winhaj David t'a heb' soldado: Ha mach sb'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ochokab' t'a sb'e ha ha' tz'ochk'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', smilancham masanil heb' max uji yilan yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi. Ha wal juntzanh heb' chi', tzin yaj heb', xchi winh. Ata' elnakkankot jun lolonel tz'alji: Ha heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' tz'em sb'eyi, max yal-laj yoch heb' t'a yol spalakio winh rey, xchi.

Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj David chi' t'a kuartel ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', ix yak'an skuch winh Schonhab' Winhaj David, ix laj sb'oank'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak, ix schael yich b'aj ix mukchaj jun ch'olan.
Ha Jehová Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil, a ayoch yet' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' te niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix schekkot heb' smunlajwum winh t'a winhaj David, haton heb' nhikum te' yet' heb' mak'umpoj k'een, ix yik'anpaxkot te' k'ute' heb', yik sb'oank'e spat winhaj David chi' heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj snachajel yuj winhaj David chi' to a Jehová ix ak'ankanoch winh reyal, yik te niwan tz'aj sb'inaj schonhab' Jehová chi', yujto te xajan yuj.
Ayik ix el winhaj David chi' t'a Hebrón, ix jawi winh t'a Jerusalén, ix kajnaj winh ta'. Ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix, ix yik' winh, yuj chi' tzijtumto yal yuninal winh ix alji.

Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón, winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok Israel, ix kot heb' masanil yak' owal yet' winh, palta ayik ix yab'an winh, ix em winh b'aj ay juntzanh k'een niwak tenam yik wach' syak' owal chi' winh.
Ha heb' filisteo chi' ix k'och heb' t'a spanhanil Refaim, ix sb'oank'e skampamento heb' ta'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi': --Ixik, ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha in ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh yet' heb' soldado b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Ata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winh: Ha Jehová ix jakanb'at jun b'e t'a wichanh t'a skal heb' wajk'ol tik, icha wal tz'aj sb'at nhepnaj junok ha' eluma', xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' filisteo chi', ix laj yaktejkan sdiosal heb', haxo winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado ix ik'ankoti.
Ix jaxpax heb' filisteo chi' t'a spanhanil Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj David chi' t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Manh ach k'och t'a sat heb', palta to ha t'a spatiktak heb' ol ach kotok. Ha b'aj ay juntzanh te' bálsamo tzach koti.

Ayik ol ab'an sk'anh jun icha sk'anh yek' anima t'a skaltak sk'ab' te te' chi', elanhchamel tza yamoch ak'an owal yet' heb', yujto a jun chi' sch'oxani to a in ol in b'ab'laj uuj, yik ol in satanel heb' filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj rey David chi' tas ix yal Jehová. Yuj chi' ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo chi' winh, ix el yich spechan heb' winh t'a Geba masanto t'a Gezer.
